newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CEN BANK SETS TWO REV REPO TENDERS FOR WED.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CEN BANK SETS TWO REV REPO TENDERS FOR WED.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Wednesday said it had set two securities reverse repurchase tenders for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to sterilise an unspecified volume of market liquidity.
The NBS said in a statement that the operations would consist of a one-day reverse repo tender, as well as a seven-day reverse repo tender.
The NBS added the American-style tenders would have no fixed minimum rate.

According to official NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector has a liquidity surplus, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 102.75 percent as of Tuesday, after being at 102.68 percent the previous day.
